convert_k_upscaler_to_diffusers: run the script to convert a k-upscaler model checkpoint to diffusers UNet format and save it
resnet_to_diffusers_checkpoint: convert a k-diffusion resnet block weights to diffusers checkpoint format with norm and conv layers
self_attn_to_diffusers_checkpoint: convert self-attention qkv projection weights from k-diffusion checkpoint to diffusers attention format
cross_attn_to_diffusers_checkpoint: convert cross-attention kv projection weights from k-diffusion checkpoint to diffusers attention format
unet_model_from_original_config: build a UNet2DConditionModel from a k-diffusion original config with custom block types and attention settings
